title: Properties on 200 drawn portfolios
heading: Properties Must Hold on Every Drawn Portfolio
cases: every property holds on 200 drawn portfolios for the correct model, and some drawn portfolio catches a model with no budget rows
every drawn portfolio comes with a witness plan that breaks none of its rules, and most witnesses fund something
the drawn portfolios include alternatives, so a model that funds two of a group is caught
the drawn portfolios include lags, so a model that lets a child start in its parent's year is caught
the drawn portfolios include must-dos, so a model that may drop one is caught
the value the solver reports is compared with the value of the plan it returns
